  • f5f2e4e: Serve the dashboard's experimental tools choice without a lookup per request.   • 3ec0de0: ctx7 reads the deployment URL from CONTEXT7_BASE_URL when --base-url is not passed, so on-premise users set it once instead of on every command. --base-url still wins when both are set, and a custom URL from either source turns off the update check and telemetry.

nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.52.12-nightly.20261117.44016600295 Prerelease2026-11-17T05:57:59Z

Cua Driver 0.52.12-nightly.20261117.44016600295 (nightly)

Automated immutable nightly built from an exact main commit. Nightlies are opt-in, may be less stable than regular releases, and never replace stable update discovery.

Source

  • Commit: 2501dda8b61ba98fbb6a14f0dd498bbbdfda5305
  • Changes: nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.52.4-nightly.20261116.43804048942…2501dda8b61b

Changes

  • Fix: bound private-worker shutdown from admission through exit. (#7646) Thanks @cresslank.
  • Fix: keep a native sheet's buttons in a budget-limited macOS read. (#7614)
  • Test: give the GTK3 desktop-lane drag a longer window. (#7919)
  • Perf: replace fixed settles with read-backs and name shared pacing values. (#7032)
  • Fix: capture occluded windows on the nested cua-compositor. (#7918) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: deliver desktop click and scroll on the nested cua-compositor. (#7926) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: map PX keyboard focus points on the nested cua-compositor. (#7937) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: scale shared Electron PX points by the capture's frame_scale. (#7941) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: join the AT-SPI bus AT_SPI_BUS_ADDRESS names on Linux. (#7943) reported by @djnine.
  • Fix: list Windows windows without UI Automation. (#7963) reported by @janpatrickpalacio.
  • Fix: re-land the exit wait and browser_type Enter fixes from #4488 and #4499. (#7857) Thanks @its-animay, @sahiljagtap08.
  • Test: pin the macOS overlay to an upper-left mixed-scale display. (#7971) reported by @alex4o.
  • Test: cover the Linux set_value InsertText fallback for GTK, Qt and unknown toolkits. (#7975) Thanks @blaketyndall-eng.
  • Fix: name the failed Hyprland input availability predicate. (#7983) Thanks @chrisohearn.
  • Fix: stop re-sending input that may already have landed. (#5574) Thanks @only21mil.
  • Fix: document macOS background Save Automation consent. (#5776) reported by @nick-inkeep.
  • Fix: attach existing Chrome profiles after one consent, honestly. (#7999)
  • Fix: bind driver and testkit test sockets under a short /tmp dir. (#7064)

Contributors

Thanks to @alex4o, @blaketyndall-eng, @chrisohearn, @cresslank, @djnine, @its-animay, @janpatrickpalacio, @muness, @nick-inkeep, @only21mil, @sahiljagtap08 for contributing to or reporting changes in this nightly.

Cua Driver 0.52.11

Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

Fixes

  • attach existing Chrome profiles after one consent, honestly. (#7999)

Contributors

This release contains maintainer changes only.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

Cua Driver 0.52.9

Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

Fixes

  • list Windows windows without UI Automation. (#7963) reported by @janpatrickpalacio.

Contributors

Thanks to @janpatrickpalacio for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-driver-rs-v0.52.7cua-driver-rs: v0.52.7 Prerelease2026-11-16T16:36:54Z

Cua Driver 0.52.7

Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

Fixes

  • map PX keyboard focus points on the nested cua-compositor. (#7937) reported by @muness.

Contributors

Thanks to @muness for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

react@0.1.13@openviking/react 0.1.13 Stable2026-11-16T19:06:29Z

en-US

Patch Changes

  • ae0ce7a: Add the named compile workflow and its CLI guide. FileBrowser now reports selected tree entries so hosts can add directory references to VikingBot, whose send button uses a rounded square.

  • 62d5cd5: Support switching named compilation configurations through directory-style tabs, native Git snapshot history, and Wiki edits with explicit snapshots.

    Propagate pending Wiki conflicts from deeply nested files to every ancestor directory, including collapsed subtrees, and refresh cleared markers. Preserve conflict tags loaded after an older empty index, and let refreshed conflict results override historical compilation counts. Skip inaccessible directory placeholders while traversing containers with readable descendants. Respect write-permission changes in open configuration editors, compare the first version against an empty baseline, and refresh the current version after a restore conflict before allowing another confirmation.

    Align compilation settings with directory and Skill pickers, full-path tooltips, frequency radio cards and time selection. Add file selection, historical comparison and file restore to Wiki history in a full-width document panel with the FileViewer diff renderer, hide history for ordinary resource files and while editing, improve pack upload, and keep model names and dashboard tooltips readable.

    Keep history loading indicators centred, show initial picker loading immediately, reuse an Arco-derived Switch, keep target paths on one line and hide view switching while editing. Fix the selected background of the history Preview / Markdown tabs.

    Complete theme fallbacks on migrated workflow roots, align dark surfaces, schedule selection borders, history badges and diff legends, and apply the console theme to Switch sizes and unavailable states. Preserve the FileViewer's native diff colours. Show the empty state when a selected directory file has no historical versions, including after retrying a failed request.

  • a08cec9: Fix Console showing a command-unavailable warning during execution. CommandConsole now accepts busy to lock input and submission while pending result cards show progress; disabled retains its unavailable message.

  • 63da276: Align the typography and colors of CommandConsole and VikingBot with the console design. Simplify completed resource import cards and add a result action to CLI completion notifications.

  • 63da276: Updating a mounted FileBrowser's controlled uri opens the preview and reveals the resource in the directory tree. Hosts that need a preview-only update can call openResource(uri, { reveal: false }). Use defaultExpandedUri to set the initial tree expansion.

  • a4c0257: Allow FileBrowser hosts to override individual experience dashboard requests while retaining the built-in UI, pagination, retries, and cancellation.

  • 0a7197c: After saving an editable ordinary file in FileBrowser, choose whether to keep a snapshot, then enter a description and save it. Snapshot failures retain the description for retry and do not undo the file save. Wiki compile files retain their automatic version history.

  • 41108b0: Hide the Preview / Source switch during editing. FileBrowser keeps version history available and copies the current editor draft.

  • 62d5cd5: Use the same theme background for the file tree panel, FileBrowser directory pane and sticky trailing actions. Keep normal, hover and selected surfaces consistent in light and dark themes without host-specific overrides, while preserving text masking during horizontal scrolling.

  • 41108b0: Replace the file path in Wiki conflict rows with a compact pencil button. File Browser opens the editor directly for pending conflicts when editing is allowed.

  • 41108b0: Use tagged data-plane search to list Wiki conflicts and mark directories with pending conflicts, even when the matching files are collapsed. Refresh conflict status after saving a Wiki file. Accept the current and legacy Compile registry response fields.

zh-CN

修复与改进

  • ae0ce7a: 新增按名称创建和执行编译的流程及 CLI 指引。FileBrowser 支持上报选中的目录树条目，宿主可将目录引用传给 VikingBot，发送按钮采用圆角方形。

  • 62d5cd5: 支持通过目录风格的页签切换编译配置、原生 Git 快照历史，以及显式保留 Wiki 编辑快照。

    Wiki 深层文件的待处理冲突沿祖先目录逐级显示，目录折叠时保留，刷新后清除已解决的标记；旧空索引不覆盖后来加载到的冲突标签，刷新结果优先于历史编译统计；跳过无权限目录占位，保留可展开目录的可读后代遍历。已打开的配置编辑器响应写权限变化，首个版本默认与空内容比较，版本回滚冲突后刷新当前版本，供用户再次确认。

    编译配置使用目录和 Skill 选择器，补充完整路径提示、频次单选卡片与时间选择。Wiki 历史使用全宽文档面板和 FileViewer 差异视图，支持文件选择、历史版本对比和文件回滚；普通资源文件及编辑状态隐藏历史入口，优化 pack 上传界面、模型名称换行与看板提示位置。

    历史加载状态保留内容高度并显示居中图标，目录和 Skill 选择器打开即进入加载态；查看变更复用迁移自 Arco 的共享 Switch，目标路径保持单行，编辑时隐藏视图切换。修复历史正文「预览 / Markdown」页签的选中背景色。

    在迁入流程的根节点补齐主题兜底，对齐暗色背景、更新频次选中边框、历史标记与差异图例，并让 Switch 的尺寸和不可用状态采用控制台主题；差异正文保留 FileViewer 原生配色；目录内文件暂无历史版本时展示空态，加载失败后重试同样正确展示。

  • a08cec9: 修复 Console 执行命令时误显示不可用提示的问题。CommandConsole 新增 busy，在等待结果时锁定输入与提交，由执行中的结果卡片展示进度；disabled 保留不可用提示。

  • 63da276: 对齐 CommandConsole 和 VikingBot 与控制台的字体及配色，精简资源导入完成卡片，并在 CLI 完成通知中添加查看结果入口。

  • 63da276: 更新已挂载的 FileBrowser 的受控 uri 时，区块会打开预览并在目录树中定位资源。需要仅更新预览的宿主可调用 openResource(uri, { reveal: false })。用 defaultExpandedUri 设置初始展开位置。

  • a4c0257: FileBrowser 支持由宿主替换经验看板的单项请求，并沿用内置界面、分页、重试和请求取消。

  • 0a7197c: FileBrowser 保存普通可编辑文件后，可选择是否保留快照，再填写描述并保存。快照失败会保留描述以供重试，不影响已保存的文件；Wiki 编译文件沿用自动版本历史。

  • 41108b0: 编辑态隐藏「预览 / 源码」切换。文件浏览区块保留版本历史，复制正文时取当前编辑草稿。

  • 62d5cd5: 统一文件树面板、FileBrowser 目录面板与行尾吸附操作区的主题背景，浅色、深色、悬停和选中态保持一致，无需宿主额外适配，并保留横向滚动时对文字的遮挡。

  • 41108b0: Wiki 冲突列表将文件路径替换为铅笔图标按钮。有编辑权限时，可从文件浏览器的待确认冲突直接进入编辑。

  • 41108b0: 通过数据面标签检索列出 Wiki 冲突，即使冲突文件所在分支处于收起状态，也能标记待确认冲突目录。保存 Wiki 文件后更新冲突状态，同时兼容当前和旧版的编译配置响应字段。

heygen-com/hyperframes ↗ 3 releases · 3 stable
v0.9.61 Stable2026-11-17T11:29:39Z

HyperFrames v0.9.61

Released on 2026-11-17.

Received projects and the files they reach stay inside their own folder across render, preview and Studio, and a sealed preview reloads in place in a fraction of a second. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.60. That version never reached npm: its publish was refused because it ran from the release PR's merge ref, and since #8020 a stable release publishes from the push to main that merges it.

Features

  • Engine: Render telemetry says why a page cannot reuse still frames (c8df284b2, #7993).
  • Studio: An element's source-parsed animations are part of Studio's API (efc91fc87, #8061).
  • Producer: Enforce expected output dimensions before capture (8a13b2caf, #7871).

Fixes

  • Producer, Parsers: Render compile never looks for a scene's assets on another computer (524ea46bf, #8063).
  • CLI: Refuse media-proxy copies another site asks for in play and the static server (f97e28905, #8058).
  • Producer: Readers re-check outside-linked compositions, and the refusal names a step every surface can take (4721739ee, #8034).
  • CLI: Leave files from outside the project out of Lambda and Cloud Run site uploads (39347da9d, #8060).
  • CLI: A host can name projects whose received files are expected or all received (5ea86450a, #8025).
  • Core: Only Studio's own preview pages get the editing port, and undo sets only safe attributes (55291c00c, #8057).
  • Lint: Match a timed wrapper's close tag literally (3e01f691d, #8028).
  • Studio: Each drag shows as its own undo step once its save lands (647bdd4d7, #8033).
  • CLI: A refused reverse start reports whether HeyGen sent the refusal (53080581c, #8053).
  • Producer: Cap a render's total sub-composition expansion (b29e40d70, #8045).
  • Inspector: The inspector's Chrome starts as root or in a container (f91bbf0da, #8050).
  • Refuse media paths that ffmpeg's image2 demuxer would read as a pattern (fe93f9cd4, #8047).

v0.9.59 Stable2026-11-17T00:49:19Z

HyperFrames v0.9.59

Released on 2026-11-16.

The preview player gets a fullscreen button, and a failed render now says why. Renders, Studio and the CLI keep to the project's own files and to public media hosts.

Features

  • CLI: Diff --hide scores a project's layer by what it adds (e6d5c699b, #7972).
  • Player: Add a fullscreen button to the preview player (5be6c1580, #7726).
  • Core: Describe replies carry the picker's element label, and studio exports standInHandle (51ae92510, #7936).

Fixes

  • Hidden and credential files stay out of Studio, history and lint (c68c78445, #7979).
  • Core: A page marked for another site gives that site only playback (c4d607c7f, #7980).
  • Studio Server: No write route touches files other tools run or trust (2a28e4368, #7964).
  • CLI: The skills update check never reads a project's git config (e368db138, #7975).
  • Lint: Run Studio and producer lint off the host's own thread (778a00564, #7974).
  • Producer: Probe sub-composition media defaults (95e4e7f88, #7550).
  • CLI: Validate and keyframes print project text with control characters as visible escapes (ce8d55d30, #7958).
  • Check: A media source that failed to load is not reported as a timeout (5e0c3db12, #7954).
  • CLI: Help shows each option's default once (d7f8d77fb, #7953).
  • CLI: Render --json gives each missing tool, a held slot and an old Node its own code (47d007e5b, #7842).
  • Sdk Playground: The Vite config loads on Node 22 before 22.18 (c7876f333, #7805).
  • Check: Mark a contrast finding by its severity and quote its text (ec5a4e2a1, #7752).
  • Player: The fix for the preview freezing when many clips share one long recording is pulled from this release, because it stopped an app embedding the preview from showing an edit (42508c1ef, #7795; reverted by 33e1a36a3, #7978).
  • Snapshot skips private files, no text-art demuxers, escaped warning text (8959deb00, #7943).
  • CLI: Capture names its local page server's port in the bypass entry (a9b0371c8, #7965).
  • CLI: A render that fails says why, even on a crash or a silent exit (2623ded13, #7957).
  • Studio: A long audio file from outside the project is never decoded for its waveform (c77cd301c, #7961).
  • Publish: Upload only what npm reads as checked; tags publish only main, next or alpha commits (5f4637977, #7959).
  • Engine: Media URL reads reach only public hosts under a restricted page network (994fbbde2, #7946).
  • Cli,engine: Pin the page server's direct host to an explicit port and the Studio's own origin (dbc9c1826, #7945).
  • Producer: A render waiting on a long audio mix says it is processing audio (df698a029, #7952).
  • Core: A capture page loads a clip with no set length only when it is due (9e5048772, #7938).
  • Studio: Beat analysis never picks a recording longer than a song (87955b890, #7944).
  • CLI: Own render-slot lock dir; refuse cache files other accounts can write (071a2da0b, #7951).
  • CLI: Never write project records through symlinks under .hyperframes (061ff5bbb, #7950).

Docs & Examples

  • Changelog: Weekly digest 2026-11-09-2026-11-16 (af873924d, #7969).
  • Publish: Say publishing waits for no approval and only admins push prerelease tags (a707e4737, #7960).

Catalog

  • CLI: Escape control characters in project, page and registry text (6f88be394, #7913).
  • Mcp: Run the MCP registry publish in the mcp-registry environment (45ff3526c, #7966).
  • Ci: A catalog publish run that main overtook ends clean instead of failing (77e675574, #7816).

Other Changes

v0.9.58 Stable2026-11-16T16:00:04Z

HyperFrames v0.9.58

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio exports a sealed preview's checked element reads and stand-ins, and renders, carve and the audio engine keep to the project's own files. This release also carries everything prepared as v0.9.57, which never reached npm.

Features

  • Studio: A sealed preview frame forwards Studio's playback keys (b741ecf13, #7844).
  • CLI: Show and open the page to manage or cancel a paid plan (b2e6076b7, #7784).
  • Studio: Export a sealed preview's checked element reads and stand-ins (a0848ad35, #7918).

Fixes

  • CLI: Check and info never probe a composition's remote media URLs (78648113d, #7942).
  • CLI: Open starts the desktop app in the home folder, not the folder it runs in (a2e7306b2, #7937).
  • CLI: Studio thumbnails and Ctrl-C cleanup under a restricted page network (707e20f18, #7941).
  • Studio Server: A host that built a page on the build worker can exit (e8f1fff5f, #7939).
  • CLI: Commands that open a composition honor PRODUCER_RESTRICT_PAGE_NETWORK (49e9424ba, #7935).
  • Engine,producer,cli: Media inputs refuse formats that open other files (ead110aab, #7931).
  • Engine: Check the resolved address of a restricted download under Bun too (04b690361, #7860).
  • Parsers: Bound total expansion in the GSAP timeline inliner (aed28486f, #7930).
  • Nested .hyperframes stays private, capture page server checks Host, project manifests pin no CLI (d5f0b1a5b, #7927).
  • Studio Server: Sub-composition previews build off the request thread within a deadline (d159ec51c, #7857).
  • Publish: A first release attempt no longer fails looking for an artifact a retry would reuse (9f85cf0a2, #7929).
  • Player: The Safari audio check no longer flakes on a clean ten-take play (916bcc83a, #7685).
  • Core: A color-graded video's dissolve and wipe play in preview and export (889143eac, #7756).
  • Media Use: The carve bundle exports analyseCarveDynamics, so carve runs again (94e499d8c, #7893).
  • Parsers: Past 10,000 identical elements every id is still unique (472909914, #7919).
  • Producer: The plan copy checks every project entry, whatever its name (7aaeb9371, #7906).
  • Producer: Render compile never inlines private project files named by @font-face (209477b65, #7925).
  • Studio: The preview picture takes its box's size in the same frame, scaled or not (1e040f6fe, #7907).
  • Engine,producer: Render media readers skip private project files and text-art input (6411df4e3, #7928).
  • Media Use: Carve runs its own copy of core's analysis, never the project's (25c603521, #7926).
  • Studio: A host that shows a still gets a preview reload with one page at a time (dab8dc807, #7905).
  • Warnings that name project files print control characters as visible escapes (d42bbd67f, #7863).
  • Studio: Recovery drafts are kept by each project's own server, never the browser (2be03408d, #7904).
  • Media Use: Audio engine reads and writes only inside the project folder (c2c6d8c59, #7897).
  • CLI: Batch outputs from a template that starts with a placeholder stay in the working folder (cf44c60cd, #7868).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Style-sampling pulls the template every time, so a received copy is checked first (d796fd59e, #7924).

Internal

  • Skills: Read the ClawHub token from the main-only clawhub environment (5d5e2c062, #7923).
  • Studio Server: Give tests the CLI's 20 s ceiling so a busy CI runner stops timing them out (8ec98be29, #7933).
  • Engine: Browser pool tests never start the host's cached Chrome (cadcdb955, #7759).
  • Publish: Publish only tarballs npm reads the way the check does (dac0468f7, #7922).
  • Publish: Bind Lambda release retries to immutable run artifacts (8e8eeb205, #7920).
  • Publish: The release keeps only Lambda assets npm pins or this run built (11a7d2749, #7880).

v2026.11.5openclaw 2026.11.5 Stable2026-11-17T10:47:56Z

2026.11.5

Highlights

  • Restart-safe conversations: Queued messages, send permissions, and final chat writes are retained across Gateway restarts. (#196923, #196540, #196493) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant.
  • Safer updates: Failed Doctor or Gateway startup rolls back an activated update, while restored npm packages remain readable by non-root services. (#197851, #193272) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
  • Telegram widgets: Interactive widgets now render in Telegram messages, including private-chat topics. (#196991, #198022). Related #197923 Thanks @obviyus and @dankarization.
  • Faster memory recovery: Large memory-index rebuilds finish reliably, and embedding indexing recovers when a gateway truncates a batch-limit error. (#196378, #187797). Related #187788 Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @garrytan, @obviyus, and @fredtanxo.
  • More reliable model fallback: A configured primary account no longer blocks Claude CLI fallback, and OpenAI sessions recover from compaction item conflicts. (#198427, #198357). Related #158421 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @alkor2000, and @HerbertHuerto.
  • Usable device folders: Existing device folders remain selectable with the default runtime, and each folder choice gets a clear, compact menu row. (#190065, #190088) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • Content boundaries: Binary attachments no longer become garbled prompt text, and authenticated browser CDP URLs stay out of tool results. (#198309, #196262). Related #198289 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mulderp82, @PollyBot13, and @sallyom.

Changes

  • Busy-session messages and security presets: Personal-mode messages steer compatible work or queue quietly instead of requiring a manual resend. The personal and corporate security presets provide coherent defaults; explicit settings and mandatory access/approval limits still apply. (#185477) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant.
  • Compaction: Set maxSummaryChars to control the summary character cap. (#196207). Related #194408 Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, and @garrytan.
  • Knowledge: Keep pages within a read-sized budget and extract sections without loading an oversized page. (#186270) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Breaking: harness and plugin session control: Third-party harnesses must register session-keyed active runs inside the host runAttempt callback and retain the returned cleanup function. Plugin RPC handlers must replace chatAbortControllers/chatQueuedTurns with authorized Gateway method dispatch. Start-owner observations use startDeadlineAtMs instead of expiresAtMs; bundled consumers are migrated. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.

Fixes

  • Authorization: Queued automation runs recheck access to owner-private memory before starting, and failed child results remain deliverable after the parent turn ends. (#198697, #197658). Related #198695 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, and @obviyus.
  • Conversation history: Refreshes retain keyed commentary, transcript reads survive concurrent database preparation, and completed empty attempts no longer clutter history. (#188180, #188055, #188111) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @fuller-stack-dev, and @jalehman.
  • Gateway recovery: Resume interrupted turns after workspace preparation, preserve graceful shutdown when restart intent stalls, and acknowledge uploads before workspace preparation. (#196423, #188047, #188728) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @TameTheGame, and @vincentkoc.
  • Gateway reload: Configuration updates no longer hang when the file watcher wins the reload race; MCP listener work is cancelled when shutdown starts. (#192701, #197119) Thanks @RomneyDa, @zeroaltitude, and @obviyus.
  • Cron scheduling: Preserve scheduled account selection, restart retry deadlines and completion-run identity; handle late scheduler wakeups without silently dropping jobs. (#180677, #197449, #197484) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @giodl73-repo, @Stronggenetics, and @obviyus.
  • Cron lifecycle: Configuration hot reload no longer aborts in-flight jobs; startup deadlines and cancellation remain effective, and disabled automatic scheduling releases idle workers. (#197606, #188982, #196387). Related #197591 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @wupingyuan81-oss.
  • Quiet automations: False trigger checks stay out of chat, and main-session automations can run from a DM without failing before the model call. (#188594, #188700, #180603). Related #180602, #197181 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @Suiah98.
  • Telegram replies and approvals: Restore ACP replies in progress-stream mode and keep approvals inside their private or forum topic. (#197191, #198038, #192162). Related #195899, #197907, #125166 Thanks @bach205, @obviyus, @dankarization, @claxman, and @Waste2Time.
  • Telegram hooks and controls: Supply the runtime session key to delivery hooks and render disabled buttons as non-interactive. (#197519, #191647). Related #197186, #197669, #191645 Thanks @lester076, @obviyus, @rodricksz4h5, @tommyjoseph, and @aspalagin.
  • Channels: Deliver captioned Feishu media with block streaming disabled, normalize Unicode directory matches in Matrix and Mattermost, and prevent crafted Matrix formatting from stalling mention checks. (#191585, #187881, #187199, #184432) Thanks @RomneyDa, @forrystudio, @xialonglee, @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, and @LeizhenZhang.
  • iOS voice: Keep Talk working while the phone is locked and prevent the speech-permission Allow action from crashing the app. (#187864, #196822). Related #185664 Thanks @RomneyDa, @brianmcguire, @ultrakorne, and @obviyus.
  • Talk startup: Voice requests no longer stall before the backing agent starts, and failed startup registrations are released. (#183586, #187840). Related #187838 Thanks @RomneyDa, @bdjben, @brokemac79, and @shakkernerd.
  • Control UI: Prevent WebKit freezes while replacing an opening menu and avoid event-listener failures while chat details update. (#198658, #198380) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Host desktop: Finish VNC authentication during readiness probes so repeated checks do not trigger server lockouts. (#193487). Related #193444 Thanks @SebTardif, @obviyus, and @lakemike.
  • Keyboard and search: Preserve IME navigation in the worktree picker, provide a keyboard skip to the composer, and match canonically equivalent Unicode attachment names. (#187732, #180896, #187674) Thanks @RomneyDa, @ooiuuii, @obviyus, @goutamadwant, @LiuwqGit, and @huwei-xydt.
  • UI responsiveness: Avoid accumulated WebKit slowdown after repeated session switches; release static loading animations and settle aborted data-URL previews. (#194027, #194146, #191451) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @wangjx-xydt.
  • Provider continuity: Keep provider checkpoints available across credential-source and model switches. (#200063, #200208) Thanks @obviyus.
  • OpenAI and Anthropic: Preserve saved-context replay when hooks override requests, and keep Anthropic session prompts stable across completion wakes and message routes. (#199451, #197835, #197925) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @obviyus.
  • Claude CLI and providers: Recover after a failed live-session cleanup, reconnect after settled local transport failures, and include Claude CLI models without requiring an Anthropic model pin. (#198224, #187375, #191148). Related #195431, #187023 Thanks @obviyus, @mdarapour, @wtfichigo, @etzelm, and @Takhoffman.
  • Model discovery: Avoid slow reads with large model configurations and recover provider discovery during concurrent SDK imports. (#198837, #196448). Related #195477 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @1052326311, and @WG-Mojo.
  • Provider routing: Keep OpenRouter requests on their own endpoint; config writes no longer silently switch models to API-key billing. (#185294, #191326). Related #185272 Thanks @vishnusenthil-16, @obviyus, and @etzelm.
  • Rate limits: Respect the configured maximum retry delay after tool execution instead of holding a session lane for an oversized wait. (#197611). Related #168101 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kringsc.
  • Doctor and upgrades: Bound Doctor startup waits, honor SIGTERM, and avoid stalling live sessions during hosted checks. (#187936, #191125) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Update reliability: Keep database restoration available while progress polls during Doctor, tolerate harmless empty-WAL transitions, preserve failed post-plugin Doctor warnings, and recognize successful Gateway startup before post-update checks. (#192083, #193134, #192942) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • macOS onboarding: Preserve the installer terminal handoff so onboarding can install plugins without detached npm terminal failures. (#200247). Related #200244 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @miguelbranco80.
  • Stored state: Restore cold transcripts for renamed agents before repair, tolerate retained deleted-agent databases, and isolate held databases until explicit restoration. (#196079, #198145, #198180). Related #196066 Authored by @steipete.
  • Backups: Compact snapshots inside the staging directory, inspect the backup engine without copying the live database, and preserve SQLite corruption diagnostics. (#194230, #194234, #194497). Related #194208, #194209 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @GoatInAHat.
  • Backup diagnostics: Identify busy files during backup capture and retry transient Windows access failures without weakening integrity checks. (#193685) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @wr-web.
  • Update recovery: Handle state-path aliases, live cleanup writes and environment-only service overrides without losing restoration progress. (#189004, #189628, #196371) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Update cleanup: Avoid false failures from leftover snapshot copies or NFS snapshot-directory cleanup, and preserve external plugin data during rehearsal. (#193702, #195409, #196301). Related #195396 Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, and @tianping.
  • Cold storage and startup: Avoid worker out-of-memory failures during large transcript-index repair, restore cold PostgreSQL conversations after idle readers close, and avoid database-clone stalls during Gateway startup. (#194099, #189991, #190918) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @etzelm, and @Frosmans.
  • Memory and SQLite: Avoid redundant Dreaming inventory reads, release completed SQLite readers, and prevent cursor restarts. (#180692, #190242). Related #180657 Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @lisandromachado, and @ava-perry.
  • Plugin rebuilds: Release obsolete plugin-generation state instead of growing Gateway memory after every rebuild. (#199042) Thanks @etzelm and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Packages and discovery: Ship PostgreSQL declarations, point packaged plugin exports at compiled runtime files, and restore Bonjour discovery in npm installs. (#188091, #188639, #199156) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @galiniliev, and @alfredjbclaw.
  • Browser and workflow paths: Preserve native CORS preflights, avoid Lightpanda navigation timeouts, and keep literal workflow paths intact instead of trimming whitespace. (#185028, #196400, #187785) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @eleqtrizit, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
  • CLI and configuration: Offer help flags in shell completion, allow dotted-path insertions in JSON and YAML, and stop pending cron inventory reads on interrupt. (#187799, #187828, #187726) Thanks @bajiaoshan, @obviyus, @LinzeShi, and @SunnyShu0925.

OpenWhispr/openwhispr ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.12.01.12.0 Stable2026-11-17T10:27:25Z

OpenWhispr 1.12.0

A new assistant window you can talk to from any app, Private notes and Teams for workspaces, and one-screen local setup.

🌟 Highlights

  • 🎙️ A new assistant window — Press the assistant hotkey in any app and speak or type. It answers in its own window, edits the text you selected, or types the answer into the field you're in. It asks you questions mid-task, drafts emails and Slack replies for you to edit and send, and keeps your chat when you minimize it.
  • 🔒 Private notes — Every workspace gets a Private section for your own notes, and it follows you across devices.
  • 👥 Teams, Teamspaces and Guests — A People page with bulk invites and removals, plus an overview of every teamspace.
  • 🧭 One-screen local setup — Recommended models for your computer, downloaded for you.
  • 📡 Signed model registry — New and retired models arrive between releases. Turn it off in Settings → Privacy.
  • 💬 Background chats — Leave a chat mid-answer and it keeps going, and several can answer at once.
  • 🏢 Organization controls — Managed device policy, update policy and local model allow lists.

✨ Also new

  • The assistant replies in Slack threads, reads your calendar with the right weekdays, and no longer claims it sent something it didn't
  • Import your Dragon vocabulary
  • OpenRouter speech-to-text
  • Choose your default summary template
  • Better speaker ID for Chinese and English meetings

🛠 Fixes

  • Accounts on one computer no longer share history, chats or dictionary.
  • Team notes no longer stall after a sync conflict.
  • Meetings drop stray wrong-script fragments and match speakers better.
  • Windows: the mic opens faster and the pill stays draggable. Linux: works without AVX2. macOS: skipping Accessibility now explains why text was only copied.

Full details in the changelog.

🙏 Thanks

Thanks to @Chadpiha, @greatcoat, @boseq, @IdrisGit, @kuleje, @widechaos, @henmedia, @hpflatorre, @Ker102, @injaamam, @maxazure, @mariushm, @clarkmaan and @etzelm. 🎉

EpicGames/lore ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.14.0 Stable2026-11-17T09:25:59Z

The latest release of Lore, Epic Games' next-generation open source version control system.

Quickstart | Design | Documentation | Discord

Quick Install

Windows

irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

macOS / Linux

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

Release Notes

Changes since v0.13.0.

Breaking changes

  • Branch metadata keys archived, restored, restoring and released are reserved for archives and restores; remove or rename values stored under them before upgrading
  • An invalid LORE_AUTH_STORE, or a user-level config.toml that can't be read or parsed, stops every command. Commands relayed to the service without LORE_AUTH_STORE use the secure store
  • The Lore service and its clients must come from the same build; end a running service after upgrading
  • Requests the server or authentication service refuses fail with NotAuthenticated (16) or NotAuthorized (17) instead of an internal error (255), NotConnected (29) or a not-found code
  • lore branch create with an invalid name and a refused lore repository instance move exit with InvalidArguments (3); lore clone --root-file with a missing file exits with 82
  • C API: push events start with their repository and branch, and the instance-delete begin event drops dry_run. Rebuild against the new lore.h
  • Switching, resetting or pushing to an archived branch leaves it archived; lore push restores it, other clients restore it with a branch create
  • Mutable store plugins must remove a key swapped to zero and refuse a swap from a non-zero value on an absent key
  • lore-server: a remote immutable store trusts its upstream and checks only payload sizes (verify = true restores full checks)
  • lore-server: QUIC storage request failures log under the lore_server::quic target

Features

  • Virtual clones on Linux with lore clone --vfs fuse, served from the shared store and supporting status, stage, commit, sync, reset and merge. --vfs default now picks FUSE on Linux
  • lore clone --vfs fuse --prefetch <file> warms the store from an access recording (LORE_FUSE_RECORD_DIR)
  • lore repository instance clone copies an instance on a shared store, sharing data blocks on APFS, Btrfs, XFS, ReFS and Dev Drive
  • [auth] in the user-level config.toml chooses the token store (store, path)
  • Per-instance ignore rules in .lore/ignore
  • --fast-flush writes the local store's index in place, which is faster on Windows
  • [store] cache_payloads sets whether fetched and written content is kept in the store
  • The Lore service closes remote connections idle for 5 minutes (idle_connection_timeout)
  • lore-unix:// remotes reach a machine server through a Unix socket (LORE_UDS_SOCKET), which lore-server serves to containers with [server.uds]
  • lore-server: client_credentials_scopes for OIDC providers, requested by lore auth login --client-id
  • lore-server: round-robin read replica selection for composite stores (read_replica_selection)
  • lore-server: HTTP range requests on the content and presigned endpoints
  • lore-server: ThinClientService.RevisionTree can attribute entries to the revision that last changed them
  • lore-server: server.upstream_connections sets the connections to a remote store's upstream (default 4)

Fixes & Improvements

  • lore push pushes branches, layers and links up to 8 at a time, and each linked branch only once
  • Faster lookup of the revision shared with the remote, without endless loops or wrong merge bases
  • Fixed concurrent branch creates, restores, archives and metadata edits undoing each other
  • Merges, cherry-picks, reverts and syncs handle case-only renames on both sides
  • Fixed lore file dirty, lore file dirty move and lore stage move losing moves or dropping files from a commit
  • Fixed forced stages, unstages and merges under a sparse view corrupting or losing changes
  • Replacing a file with a folder, or the reverse, reports a merge conflict instead of failing with Not a directory
  • Fixed several merge, resolve, reset and obliterate problems inside links
  • Instances on a shared store keep their file times in .lore/records/, so they no longer rewrite each other's
  • Commands that change the user-level config.toml keep settings they don't know
  • Fixed content missing from the local store after concurrent reads or eviction, and commits failing with "leader upload failed"
  • C API revision-tree handles are safe under concurrent deletes and moves
  • SWFS: release builds need no dynamic C runtime, and files a sync brings back are no longer missing
  • lore-server: fixed lore push --fast-forward-merge storing revisions with mismatched directory hashes
  • lore-server: DynamoDB compare-and-swap fixes for zero values and refused swaps
  • lore-server: the replicated immutable store spreads requests over several connections (num_clients)
  • lore-server: fixed RevisionDiff and RevisionTree results around links and merges
  • lore-server: accepts partition-scoped tokens from a separate token_exchange_issuer

Release Assets

[!IMPORTANT] These can be downloaded under the "Assets" section below.

Installer

  • lore-setup - Lore CLI Windows installer

Binaries

  • lore - Lore CLI
  • loreserver - Lore Server
  • liblore - Lore Shared Library

Headers

  • lore.h - Single header for liblore (packaged with liblore)

Supported Platforms

  • Windows x86_64
  • macOS AArch64
  • Linux x86_64
  • Linux AArch64
  • Linux AArch64, optimized for Graviton/Neoverse 512-tvb

  • Windows: Lore-Desktop-Setup-x64.exe
  • macOS: Lore-Desktop-arm64.dmg
  • Linux (Ubuntu 24.04): lore-desktop_amd64.deb
  • Linux (AppImage): Lore-Desktop-x86_64.AppImage

v0.23.2Hermes Agent v0.23.2 Stable2026-11-16T20:59:18Z

Hermes Agent v0.23.2

Release Date: November 16, 2026

Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~1,989 PRs merged since v0.23.1 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

About this release

Measured at commit ae2a81ccc00, the window since v0.23.1 contains 7,918 non-merge commits across 5,211 changed files (+239,733 / −22,788), 1,989 merged PRs and 940 closed issues.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: durable subagents that survive a gateway restart or crash and can be continued on their own conversation, one prompt-cache clock per session, hermes fallback check for fallback-chain readiness, hermes update --force to stop gateways at once instead of draining, one-time browser_vault codes entered from Telegram and Discord, opt-in shared Telegram DM threads, the Gemini Interactions API by default for Gemini 3 and later plus Gemini 4 Carbon, fast mode for Claude Mythos 5.2, per-job cron options (wrap_response, a fresh thread per run), new plugin APIs (ctx.fork_session, ctx.redact_text(), ctx.register_idle_task), compatibility shims so updates work across module moves, a slimmer macOS bundle that installs Chromium on first use, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

Fixed in the release candidate

  • Desktop chats created by an August build with a bare custom provider can send again after updating (#156545).
  • A Desktop or TUI reply that streamed beside a todo or memory call now settles instead of leaving the Stop button up (#156553).
  • A crash mid-stream on Telegram and other edit-streaming chats no longer shows a duplicate "Recovered reply"; a word holding a key prefix mid-word (program_id) is shown on time again (#156546).
  • Desktop no longer loses or scrambles what you type while it starts and resumes your last chat (#156615, #156642).
  • After a reconnect mid-reply, Desktop shows the reply once and in full, attachments included (#156611).
  • In the Webapp, opening Hermes Cloud agents while this install isn't signed in to Nous Portal now tells you to sign in to Nous Portal instead of sending you to the Webapp login (#156652).
  • Exiting the CLI while its startup update check is waiting on GitHub no longer leaves git running (#156616).

Updating

  • Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
  • Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
  • CLI: hermes update, or re-run the installer one-liner.
  • Docker / Hermes Cloud: nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable (or :latest).

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.34CC Switch v4.0.34 Stable2026-11-17T07:06:04Z

CC Switch v4.0.34

本版本的技能仓库支持 GitLab、Gitea 和 Forgejo（包括自建实例和 Codeberg），不再只能添加 GitHub 上的仓库。会话管理里现在可以直接删除 Antigravity CLI 的会话；开启自动下载更新后，发现新版本会立刻开始下载。另外，WorkBuddy 手动添加的模型可以设置思考强度，S3 同步也可以像 WebDAV 一样清除本机保存的配置。

另外修复了 Gemini CLI 的供应商「获取模型列表」报 Key 无效或拿到空列表；Codex 里的 GitHub Copilot 模型被当成不支持图片；阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS 用不了 S3 同步；Skills 目录里有失效链接时整个云同步上传失败；路由模式下 Fable 5.2 被显示成 Fable 5；Copilot 上的 Gemini 模型缓存命中率低；Copilot 上勾了 1M 的 Fable 模型请求失败等问题。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

技能仓库支持 GitLab、Gitea 和 Forgejo

「管理技能仓库」以前只接受 github.com 的地址，现在也能添加 GitLab、Gitea、Forgejo 上的公开仓库（需求见 #1324、#4227），包括自建实例和 Codeberg：

  • 填 owner/name 仍按 GitHub 处理；填其他站点的完整地址时，CC Switch 会先问一次这个站点是 Gitea / Forgejo 还是 GitLab，再按对应的方式下载。自定义端口、GitLab 的多级分组、Gitea 页面上复制的地址都能用。
  • 浏览技能、安装、检查更新和「打开文档」链接都会去仓库所在的站点。
  • 只支持公开仓库，地址必须是 https。Gitee 暂不支持（它的下载接口需要令牌）。
  • 同一个 owner/name 只能保留在一个站点上，在另一个站点添加同名仓库会替换原来的。

在会话管理里删除 Antigravity CLI 会话

以前 Antigravity 的会话只能在 agy 里删。现在可以在会话管理里直接删除 Antigravity CLI 的会话，删除时会和 agy 自己一样，把它的会话索引和摘要一并清理，重启 agy 后不会再冒出来。

  • 会话正在 agy 里打开时不能删，先在 agy 里关掉它。
  • Antigravity IDE 的会话，以及只有索引、没有会话记录的会话，仍然要在 Antigravity 里删除。

发现新版本后立刻开始自动下载

开启「自动下载更新」后，以前要等启动约 1 分钟后的后台检查才开始下载，「关于」页只显示有新版本，看起来像开关没生效。现在启动时一发现新版本就开始下载，「关于」页的新版本提示下会显示「正在后台下载新版本…」或「已下载完毕」。安装确认框的图标、文字和按钮也重新对齐了。

WorkBuddy 手动添加的模型可以设置思考强度

预设里的 WorkBuddy 模型早就能在 WorkBuddy 的模型菜单里选思考强度，手动添加或从模型列表选的模型却只有思考开关（见 #9599）。现在打开思考后，模型详情里可以勾选要提供的「思考强度」，并设置「可以关闭思考」；都不勾时仍只显示思考开关。从模型列表获取的模型也会按 Pi 表单的规则自动填上可用的强度。

S3 同步可以清除本机配置

S3 同步设置新增「清除配置」，和 WebDAV 一样：从本机删除保存的区域、存储桶、密钥、端点和远程目录，并停止自动同步，存储桶里已经上传的数据不会删除。

修复

  • Gemini CLI 的供应商「获取模型列表」报 Key 无效，或者用兼容网关时拿到空列表（见 #8546）：以前按 Authorization: Bearer 发 AI Studio Key，Google 不认；现在按 Gemini 原生方式获取。上一版修好的是 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 选 Gemini Native 格式的供应商，这次修的是 Gemini CLI 自己的供应商。
  • Codex 里用 GitHub Copilot 时，支持图片的模型被当成只支持文字（#8027，见 #7977）：获取模型列表时会读取 Copilot 声明的图片输入能力。已经添加的 Copilot 供应商，请重新获取模型列表并保存，再完全退出并重启 Codex。
  • 阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS 用不了 S3 同步，被提示 Access Key 错误（见 #3996）：这三家的新存储桶拒绝旧的路径式地址，现在会自动改用把存储桶放在域名里的地址。MinIO、R2 等其他服务不变。
  • S3 同步设置里选的服务商，重新打开设置页后没记住（#8644）。
  • Skills 目录里有失效的链接时，云同步整个上传失败（见 #9615）：失效的符号链接，或 Windows 上打不开的目录联接，以前会让上传整体中止（Windows 上报 os error 5），下载时也会在备份现有 Skills 这一步失败。现在跳过这类链接并记录警告。
  • 路由模式下上游是 Fable 5.2 时，Claude Code 的 /model 仍显示 Fable 5（见 #9608）：Fable 5.2 / 5.1 现在写成对应版本的模型 ID，Claude Desktop 同样修正。
  • 经 GitHub Copilot 用 Gemini 模型时，长会话的缓存命中率只有约 27%（见 #9613）：Claude Code 每一轮都会追加一条系统消息，Copilot 看起来会把它们都挪到请求开头，导致每轮请求的开头都变了。现在只对 Copilot 上的 Gemini 模型，把会话中途的系统消息按原位置作为用户消息发送，开头不再变化。其他供应商和模型不受影响。
  • 经 GitHub Copilot 用 Fable 模型并勾选 1M 时，请求报 400：Copilot 没有 1M 版本的 Claude 模型，现在会退回同版本的普通模型。获取过 Copilot 模型列表后，没有 1M 版本（上下文也不到 1M）的模型不能再勾 1M；已经勾了的会列在提示里，建议取消，因为 Claude Code 仍会按 1M 规划上下文。
  • 在设置里改了 Hermes 的配置目录后，供应商没有写进新目录（#9567）。
  • MCP 连通性检测或 DeepSeek Harness 登录出过一次内部错误后，要重启 CC Switch 才能再用（#9572）。
  • 供应商名称、地址或模型名里带 mistral 字样，就会被当成 Mistral 处理思考强度（#9573）：现在只认官方地址 api.mistral.ai。
  • 新增 Qwen4 Max 的价格（#9612）。

升级说明

数据库版本从 26 升到 27，为技能仓库记录它所在的站点。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

致谢

感谢 @SaladDay（S3 清除配置、Hermes 配置目录同步、Mistral 识别、锁恢复，以及本版约 45 个 PR 的代码整理：拆分大文件、合并重复逻辑、删除没用的代码和界面文案、补齐前后端一致性测试）、@paulo-t（GitLab 技能仓库）、@EdwinDigital（Copilot 模型图片能力）、@Dopetaiga（记住 S3 服务商）、@kilingzhang、@xiaoyx1107（国内云 S3 地址）、@yreidev（Qwen4 Max 价格）的贡献。

感谢 @xzxiaoshan、@mercutiojohn、@axlrose、@LeenixP、@loseheart-dev、@kebe7jun、@hurleychin 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。

1jehuang/jcode ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.0.0 Stable2026-11-17T04:01:22Z

Swarms, Cloud, and a lighter terminal

Highlights

  • Reworked swarms plan jobs in phases and parallel lanes, automatically start workers as dependencies finish, and show the whole team's progress in one pinned view
  • jcode Cloud officially launches: move a session or coordinated swarm to a VM with /cloud, keep working after disconnecting, and bring the conversation and repository back with /local
  • A lighter terminal with lower CPU usage, fewer background wakeups, faster transcript rendering, and less rendered-text memory

Improvements

  • In our own jcode development sessions, worker launches increased from 88 to 174 between November 2–8 and November 9–15, averaging roughly three times as many worker dispatches per active session
  • A profiled release client used 25% less CPU, idle client wakeups fell from 2.68 to 1.51 per second, and rendered-span memory in a large conversation fell from 20.4 MB to 14.6 MB
  • Spinner-frame processing became 3.5 times faster and append-frame processing on a 4,000-message transcript became 8.3 times faster
  • Cloud sessions load recent history first and fetch older messages on demand; a 7,000-message session's initial history payload shrank from 14.3 MB to 261 KB
  • Search full conversations in /resume with typo tolerance, live previews, and local and cloud sessions in the same picker
  • Set account priority tiers, hot-swap accounts with Ctrl+Alt+J/K, inspect refreshed /usage cards, and configure context limits per session
  • Follow live and completed codemode calls through bounded JavaScript previews that survive status changes and transcript compaction
  • See worker lane progress and final reports in completion messages, with clearer wait and recovery outcomes
  • Reduce polling and redraws in background windows, preserve focus state across reloads, and reuse immutable transcript and provider request data instead of repeatedly copying it
  • Live voice input includes a waveform and streaming draft transcript; model discovery and response-observed usage attribution are improved

Fixes

  • Recover from short network interruptions and HTTP/2 stream errors without prematurely failing the turn or suggesting an unrelated model switch
  • Improve account failover acknowledgements, retry cancellation, and protection against stale fallback resends
  • Keep the terminal in TUI mode after recovered draw panics, including tiny tmux panes
  • Improve cloud handoff recovery, repository replacement safety, reconnection, and in-place runtime reloads
  • Avoid repeated redraws for unchanged todo snapshots and repeated reads of completed background-task files

Full changelog: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.99.1...v1.0.0

Wei-Shaw/sub2api ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.2.22Sub2API 0.2.22 Stable2026-11-17T02:48:12Z

AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

分组新增强制 OpenAI Ultra Fast 档位，Vertex 账号支持 us/eu 多区域端点；同时大幅优化单用户高并发扣费、调度快照与请求体解析性能。

新增功能

  • 分组强制 Ultra Fast：OpenAI / Composite 分组可强制 service_tier=ultrafast，仅对支持的模型（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol）生效，可与强制 Fast 并存（优先级 Ultra Fast > Fast > 客户端）
  • Vertex 多区域：Gemini 账号支持 us/eu 多区域端点，不支持的模型自动走 global；发往多区域的请求在默认定价下按 1.1 倍计费（分组/渠道自定义价格不受影响）
  • 新增 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型支持，补齐 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 计费
  • OpenAI 透传账号可选按模型白名单过滤调度
  • 并发等待 ping 支持配置 concurrency.ping_interval=0 关闭，避免提前写入 HTTP 状态码

优化改进

  • 同一用户的扣费按用户通道合并结算，消除余额热点行排队，单用户高并发下延迟与内存显著下降
  • 调度快照加载与数据库回源按 bucket 合并，减少大分组选号时的重复加载与整组复制
  • 请求体热点路径改用零拷贝读取，Anthropic 请求路径与流事件转发减少 JSON 解码与复制
  • 分组日汇总重建与保留期清理不再阻塞 usage_logs 写入，避免清理期间用量记录丢失
  • 上游死连接检测由约 165 秒缩短到约 30 秒
  • 启动时远程价格哈希检查改为后台进行，不再阻塞服务启动
  • Gemini 原生请求按稳定前缀生成粘性会话哈希，提升隐式缓存命中
  • Bedrock 按错误语义区分封号、用例缺失、限流与内容过滤，429 只冷却对应模型
  • Kimi 支持新版月度套餐额度解析
  • Codex 分叉会话沿用父会话的 prompt cache key，保留缓存命中
  • 模型白名单禁止添加通配符条目并给出提示

Bug 修复

  • 修复 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultra Fast 计费倍率（由 2 倍修正为 6 倍，与 Astra 一致）
  • 修复 Gemini 粘性会话换号时强制按缓存读取计费的问题，改为按上游实际用量计费
  • 修复 Gemini 流式同名并行工具调用、分片工具调用参数快照丢失的问题
  • 修复 Gemini 兼容入口未转发 response_format 结构化输出的问题
  • 修复 Antigravity 兼容流思考内容未流式输出、空流后未释放粘性账号的问题
  • 修复 OpenAI 首个输出前的上游 keepalive 未转发、keepalive 后 SSE 错误无法下发的问题
  • 修复 OpenAI 兼容路径输出后的流错误未应用账号副作用、Messages 桥接首包前错误未 failover 的问题
  • 修复 OpenAI 工具 Schema 中 patternProperties、Python re 不支持的正则、嵌套 schema 编辑的兼容问题
  • 修复 Codex additional_tools 声明 ID 被改写、HTTP Responses 额外上下文未规范化的问题
  • 修复 Chat Completions 转 Responses 时 json_schema 默认 strict、对话中途 system 消息、加密函数调用内容丢失的问题
  • 修复 Chat Completions 转 Anthropic 时客户端 metadata.user_id 丢失的问题（API Key 账号）
  • 修复 Anthropic 兼容路由未执行 effort 策略、per-turn beta 丢失输出配置的问题
  • 修复 Composite 路由响应中公开模型名未还原、模型改写范围过大的问题
  • 修复 count_tokens 透传重复请求头的问题
  • 修复客户端断开后粘性绑定未写入的问题
  • 修复 Claude 并发 token 轮换后请求失败的问题
  • 修复 Claude 账号测试默认模型，改为 claude-sonnet-4-6
  • 修复 Fable 周额度读取与 7d_oi 窗口恢复后模型限流未解除的问题，5h 窗口滚动不再清空周用量读数
  • 修复 5h 窗口起点与额度重置时间不对齐的问题
  • 修复调度快照遗漏冷却中账号、openai_capabilities 与透传模型过滤配置的问题
  • 修复 RPM 覆盖值误用于其他分组、分组倍率/RPM 同步失败时清空覆盖配置的问题
  • 修复支付宝退款重试可能重复退款的问题
  • 修复按账户筛选时模型/端点分布的实际扣费被替换为账号成本的问题
  • 修复 Chat 回退与原生 Anthropic 路径响应模型记录丢失的问题
  • 修复 DeepSeek 显式 token 价格覆盖不生效的问题，补充硅基流动 Qwen3-Embedding / Reranker 兜底定价
  • 修复联网搜索在部分平台忽略账号级模式的问题
  • 修复 OpenAI 额度刷新失败导致渠道监控在异常与正常间反复切换的问题
  • 修复 Grok 媒体错误信息丢失、服务端搜索调用混入工具调用的问题
  • 修复国内厂商额度单元格与 Gemini 用量刷新时不更新或消失的问题
  • 修复渠道 Bedrock 兼容开关保存类型错误的问题
  • 修复设置注入的 HTML 被缓存导致品牌信息过期与 CSP nonce 不匹配的问题
  • 修复登录回填邮箱身份失败时 panic 的问题
  • 修复无法设置 TCP_USER_TIMEOUT 的平台上上游拨号失败的问题

tensorflow/tensorflow ↗ 1 release · 1 prerelease
v2.22.0-rc1TensorFlow 2.22.0-rc1 Prerelease2026-11-17T01:34:09Z

Release 2.22.0

TensorFlow

Breaking Changes

The TensorBoard dependency is no longer included by default. If you use tf.summary.* APIs or tf.keras.callbacks.TensorBoard, please install the tensorboard package separately (pip install tensorboard). Otherwise, TensorFlow will raise an ImportError.

In tensorflow/c/experimental/filesystem/filesystem_interface.h, removed TF_TransactionToken and associated APIs.

Major Features and Improvements

  • Support for Python 3.14 (cp314 and cp314t free-threaded concurrency) has been added across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
  • Upgraded Intel oneDNN to v3.14.1 with optimized convolution and transpose kernels.
  • Initial support for NVIDIA CUDA 13 has been added (pip install tensorflow-cuda13).
  • tf.lite:
    • Adds support for QUI4 (Quantized Unsigned 4-bit) in Dequantize operator.
    • Adds support for FP16 and BF16 in Unpack operator.
    • Adds support for FP16 in Transpose and DynamicUpdateSlice operator.
    • Transpose now supports up to 8D tensors.
    • Adds support for FLOAT8_E4M3FN and FLOAT8_E5M2 data types.

Bug Fixes and Other Changes

  • CheckpointReader: Releases GIL during read operations to prevent deadlocks under multithreading.
  • CUDA Driver: Demotes missing CUDA driver log from warning to VLOG(1) when run on CPU-only machines.
  • BatchFunction Operator: Adds num_warmup_batch_threads and per_criticality_batch_timeout_micros attributes.
  • TensorFlow API: Exports __new__ in public API golden files for subclasses of tuple (tf.io.FixedLenFeature).
  • tf.data: Fixes a bug in tf.data.Dataset.scan where state shape returned by scan_func was not strictly validated.
  • tf.image.adjust_contrast: Registers missing Python gradient for AdjustContrastv2 op. Fixes #126083.
  • tf.nn.softsign: Fixes second-order gradients of tf.nn.softsign.
  • tf.math.reciprocal: Constrains XLA registration of Reciprocal and Inv to device-supported types. Fixes #126414.
  • tf.experimental.numpy: isclose and allclose now apply rtol/atol to integer inputs.
  • tf.image.non_max_suppression: Fixes segmentation fault under jit_compile=True when boxes/scores are empty. Fixes #117245.

Thanks to our Contributors

Fission-AI/OpenSpec ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v2.1.0v2.1.0 - Global skills Stable2026-11-17T01:12:49Z

OpenSpec 2.1

OpenSpec now supports global skills for coding agents. Install the skills once and your agent can use them in every project on your machine.

As more teams adopt Vercel’s skills installer, it’s becoming a common way to install skills across coding tools. OpenSpec is adopting it too, so we can spend less time maintaining installer code and more time improving the skills themselves.

The OpenSpec workflows themselves haven't changed.

What changed

  • Skills can be installed globally. Vercel’s installer handles the location for each supported agent, whether it reads ~/.agents/skills/ or uses its own folder.
  • openspec update asks where a project's skills should live. In a repo that has its own OpenSpec skills, you choose once between keeping them in the repo and switching to global. Nothing changes until you choose.
  • openspec init --tools <ids> in a new repo installs globally. In 2.0 it wrote the skills into the repo. Add --scope project to keep them there.
  • Skills are installed by Vercel’s skills package. Installing or refreshing them needs Git and access to GitHub.

How to upgrade

Update the OpenSpec CLI, then run this in each project:

openspec update

In a repo that has its own OpenSpec skills, you'll see this choice:

Where should OpenSpec keep this project’s skills?

❯ Keep in this project   Keep the skills in this repo.
  Switch to global       Install the skills globally, for every project on this machine.

Keep in this project. Press Enter. The skills stay in your repo. Commit openspec/config.yaml, which records your choice so your teammates aren’t asked. Choose this if GitHub’s hosted Copilot agent reads the skills from the repo. You can switch later with openspec init --scope global.

Switch to global. We recommend this for most teams. The skills are installed globally on your machine, and the copies in the repo are removed. Commit the removed files. Each teammate then pulls, runs openspec update, and answers Yes when it offers to set up skills on their machine. Upgrade everyone’s CLI before you switch a repo: earlier versions only know project skills.

In CI or from an agent there is no question: update refreshes the skills where they are.

If a script sets up your repos, add --scope project to keep new repos' skills in the repo:

openspec init --scope project --tools claude

Note: openspec update replaces the built-in skill folders. If you edited a built-in skill or added a file inside one, save it first. openspec update --dry-run shows what will change.

An npm install needs Node 22.20.0 or newer. The standalone executable needs nothing. If you already ran npx skills add, keep that install and run openspec update.

See the upgrade guide for more details.

Fixes

  • The Windows executables are now labeled as OpenSpec, published by FISSION AI INC. Their file properties used to name the build tool, and an antivirus product removed openspec.exe as a threat. If the download disappears or won't run, the installer now says antivirus is the likely cause and shows the npm install command.

Full changelog: v2.0.0...v2.1.0

sinelaw/fresh ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.5.9fresh-editor 0.5.9 Stable2026-11-16T22:24:11Z

0.5.9

For live updates on Fresh, follow me on X.

Most config options below can be changed in the Settings UI - run Open Settings from the command palette (Ctrl+P).

Features

  • Theme chrome and file icons - themes can go borderless, style the gutter and explorer, and pick tab and status bar separator glyphs (including Powerline-style sections and caps). With Nerd Font icons on, the explorer and tabs show file-type icons, which themes can override. Two new built-in themes, flat and quiet, show it off (#3735)
  • Theme editor previews live - edits show in the real editor as you make them, and every theme option, glyph and icon can be edited (#3735)
  • Markdown previews of diagrams and math - in compose mode, Mermaid and LaTeX/math blocks are drawn by external tools (e.g. termaid, utftex) when installed; any code block language can be mapped to a command (#3751 by @PilotLeoYan)
  • Recent Files - File > Recent Files... (or the command palette) reopens a file you closed in this window; the list survives a restart (#3755)
  • Explorer dims gitignored entries when they are shown (#3283, #3290 by @CnsMaple)
  • Workboard - a new Orchestrator board with every workspace and agent, grouped by what needs you, by project, by folder or as a kanban; a status bar beacon jumps to the next waiting agent (#3736)
  • New Welcome screen - one short page with the latest release's changes, the essential keys and a Nerd Font switch (#3738)
  • LSP completions use the server's replace range (textEdit) (#3734 by @andsuli)
  • Clickable search arrows in the status bar step to the next/previous match (#3665 by @haigithub)
  • Ctrl+P file mode: Tab completes the longest common prefix of the matching paths (#3293, requested by @asukaminato0721; #3581 by @peyton-durand)
  • Plugins can declare map settings, edited in the Settings UI as a list of entries (#3751)

Bug Fixes

  • Windows keeps key modifiers - Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+Shift+letter are no longer read as plain keys in Windows Terminal and WezTerm (#3521, reported by @BrettKinny; #3602 by @neatsorg)
  • Ctrl/Alt+Shift+Tab are recognized, and passed through to terminal panes (#3601 by @neatsorg)
  • fresh FILE remembers the cursor position after quitting with the file open (#3748, reported by @shemgp)
  • LSP diagnostics refresh - servers like rust-analyzer and Roslyn now push updated diagnostics without an edit (#3681, #3682 by @StonesFromTheSky)
  • Live diff and git gutter ignore line-ending style - CRLF vs LF no longer marks whole files as changed on Windows (#3747 by @ezleyton)
  • Remote paths across platforms - a Windows client on a Linux host (or the reverse) no longer mangles path separators; Unix file names containing \ open correctly (#3758, #3762, #3581)
  • macOS honors XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME; existing installs keep their current directories until the new ones exist (#3496, #3497 by @LuisAlejandro)
  • Terminals restore in the directory the shell cd'd to, and an exited terminal keeps its tab name across a restart (#3740, #3074)
  • Inlay hints keep their own colour next to a highlighted bracket or search match (#3622 by @mommysgoodpuppy)
  • Word navigation in prompts handles non-ASCII letters - Ctrl+Left/Right/Backspace no longer split words like "café" (#3721 by @56steve)
  • Glob ? matches one whole character, including accented and emoji file names (#3620 by @56steve)
  • Smart Home on a wrapped line no longer lands inside a multi-byte indent character (#3619 by @neatsorg)
  • Orchestrator: a project whose folder was moved says so and offers to repoint it, instead of opening in the home folder (#3746)
  • Holding Down on the Welcome page no longer scrolls into blank space (#3739)
  • Settings: Status Bar Left/Right editor is easier to read (#3756)
  • Flatpak uses a supported runtime, silencing the end-of-life warning (#3752 by @Daniel-at-github)

Internals

  • Debian packaging updates following mentors review, and flaky test fixes (#3728, #3729, #3730, #3737, #3744, #3745, #3750, #3678 by @neatsorg)

can1357/oh-my-pi ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v18.22.0 Stable2026-11-16T21:54:22Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed slow streaming of Gemma tool calls with large arguments.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes

  • Moved binary analysis from the standalone ida and ghidra tools into the backend-neutral dsm namespace (xd://eval/dsm).
  • Replaced the ida.enabled, ida.maxOpen, and ida.idleCloseSec settings with disassembler.backend, disassembler.maxOpen, and disassembler.idleCloseSec; shared disassembler database APIs are now available under @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/disasm.

Added

  • Added Tern plan review editing and comments: double-click plans to edit them, select text to add Google Docs-style comments, and send comments to Refine.
  • Added Ghidra support with automatic setup of Ghidra, JDK, and PyGhidra when analysis is explicitly requested; Auto mode uses an installed IDA Pro when available and otherwise falls back to Ghidra.
  • Added support for sharing live analysis databases with child agents through db.handle() and dsm.open(handle).
  • Added a Force Remove option to worktree.onExit that removes session-created worktrees without prompting, including worktrees with uncommitted changes; new commits remain on the worktree branch.

Changed

  • Updated Tern plan review with a single Approve control, comment-aware Refine option, model selection, and a Save action that writes the plan while keeping review open and plan mode active.
  • Plain executable reads now display Mach-O, ELF, and PE metadata without opening an analysis database or downloading a backend; request an overview, function details, or dsm.open() to begin analysis.
  • Improved the model switcher (Alt+P / /switch) with provider filtering and per-switch thinking-level selection. In Tern, it now opens above the composer with integrated search, provider and Task/Main filters, and a thinking-level slider.

Fixed

  • Deleting or moving large directory trees inside a project no longer stalls language-server file watching (#19490 by @H4vC).
  • Reduced CPU and memory usage for long-running subagents as their sessions grow (#19486 by @H4vC).
  • Fixed commit.draft() incorrectly classifying files deleted or renamed through bash or eval as “Not yours”; they now appear under Review.

Removed

  • Removed the legacy standalone disassembler tools and their associated prompt instructions.
  • Removed the Copy and Edit-in-editor buttons from the Tern plan review sheet; use selection copying and double-click editing instead.

@oh-my-pi/collab-web

Fixed

  • Improved streaming performance in the collab viewer, preventing long replies from becoming progressively slower as they are received.

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Breaking Changes

  • TtyWriter now requires a drain threshold and callback and only supports independently reopenable TTYs. Its pending UTF-8 byte bounds are reported conservatively.

Changed

  • Large terminal repaints are handled more efficiently, reducing JavaScript-thread work and releasing oversized buffers after output drains.

Fixed

  • Fixed stalled terminal writers continuing to emit output or leaking file descriptors after shutdown.
  • Fixed terminal output preserving Unicode across chunk boundaries and safely replacing malformed surrogate sequences.

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • Terminals that support output backpressure must now implement onOutputDrain(callback), which returns an unsubscribe function; terminals without backpressure can omit both pendingOutputBytes and onOutputDrain.
  • Updated PlanReviewOverlay options to use PlanReviewOverlayChoice objects and report choice IDs to onPick and selectOption. Refine and Save actions now reflect plan feedback and saving behavior; removed disabledIndices and externalEditorName, and updated describe to receive DescribeContext.

Added

  • Added configurable model search placement, provider scopes, and an optional thinking-level slider to ModelPickerComponent; selected thinking levels are reported through onPick metadata. The native picker sheet now supports anchoring, scope styling, level display, and icon actions.
  • Added a native plan review document and dock with editable and commentable plans, quote annotations, plan-edit notifications, Approve, Save, and Cancel actions, plus model selection.

Changed

  • Provider scopes now show only the selected provider's models when a provider is chosen, with scope cycling able to return to the full model list.
  • Updated thinking-level controls to use left and right arrow keys, and refreshed the slider and footer hint presentation.
  • Retitled the plan-saving overlay to “Save plan” and updated its action label.

Fixed

  • Fixed slow scrolling and typing in long agent transcripts.
  • Fixed slow typing and cursor movement in drafts longer than 256 lines.

@oh-my-pi/pi-wire

Added

  • Added optional picker icons for tooltips and accessible names, plus an option to control the placement of the search interface.
  • Added buttons, menu, and document component kinds, including menu-row action state changes and document text editing, commenting, and uncommenting events.

What's Changed

  • perf(coding-agent): stop copying the full message list and journal per publisher flush by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19486
  • perf(tui): stop editor wrap-cache thrash and full visual-line rebuilds by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19488
  • perf(ai): scan Gemma in-band tool calls incrementally by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19487
  • perf(coding-agent): forget vanished directories in the LSP file watcher without full scans by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19490
  • perf(collab-web): keep finished Markdown blocks' DOM while streaming by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19485
  • perf(tui): reuse the agent transcript viewer's rows between paints by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19489

v18.21.0 Stable2026-11-16T15:27:57Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added

  • Added automatic detection of thinking capabilities for previously unknown models, with persistent results and support for alternate effort and token-budget request formats.

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added Modal as a hosted inference provider.

Changed

  • Changed the local speech model from Kokoro to Phonon 31M.
  • Improved reasoning capability detection by preserving unverified thinking-level support and using endpoint-specific probe results when available.

Fixed

  • Fixed xAI Grok OAuth model grok-composer-2.5-fast being incorrectly identified as non-reasoning; it now supports thinking levels from minimal through xhigh.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes

  • Updated the AgentSession run lifecycle API: agent_end is emitted once when a run can no longer resume, and agent_pause reports runs that stop while awaiting work. Replaced hasPendingAsyncWork(), settleAsyncWork(), and suppressAutoResumeUntilPrompt() with isRunActive, wakeSources, and waitForRunEnd(). Calling abort() now also ends runs paused on background work; RPC, JSON print, collaboration, and extension streams retain their existing per-loop agent_end behavior.

Added

  • Added configurable automatic subagent prewalk through task.agentPrewalkAuto, allowing per-agent on/off settings or model patterns while preserving unconditional subagent prewalk.
  • Unknown custom and discovered models now automatically detect reasoning support and remember supported reasoning effort levels for future sessions.
  • Added inline image and web-page replies: supported terminals can display local, data, and HTTP(S) images and embedded pages, while other terminals receive linked fallbacks. Added tui.renderEmbeds to disable this rendering.
  • Added interactive embedded pages in Tern replies, including click-to-visit and Escape-to-return navigation; common host, path, and file: URL forms are accepted.
  • Bash redirects can now write to all writable internal URLs, including job cancellation endpoints and handler-backed agent://, cfg://, ssh://, and xd:// URLs.
  • Added image pasting to ask form notes and ui.formDialog options via acceptImages; pasted images are returned with [Image #N] markers and described for text-only models. Unsupported prompts now clearly reject image pastes.

Changed

  • Changed the default local text-to-speech model to Phonon 31M for faster synthesis, smaller downloads, and additional voices. Existing Kokoro voice settings migrate automatically; speaking rates now range from 0.8× to 1.3×.
  • Tern /btw responses now appear as folded, interactive notes at the point where they were requested, with follow-up, copy, branch, inject, and stop actions; /btw without a prompt still opens the history view.
  • Overlapping Bash calls now share shell state, including variables, functions, aliases, options, and traps, and background jobs started by those calls continue running independently.
  • Extensions enabled or reconfigured through extensions or disabledExtensions now load into the active session without requiring a restart.
  • Rich-text pastes made during approval steering or in dialogs now preserve Markdown formatting and images when inserted into the chat editor.
  • Moving a task or resuming a session in another project now switches its agents, extensions, custom tools, and MCP servers to match the destination project without a restart.

Fixed

  • Fixed status indicators incorrectly showing the agent as idle while subagents or background work could still resume the run.
  • Fixed subagents and security scans completing while child agents were still running or queued peer messages remained.
  • Fixed conflict-region resolution when a selected side is empty or shares edge lines with surrounding code.
  • MCP stdio server failures before a response now report the process exit code or terminating signal instead of only reporting closed stdout.
  • Fixed prewalk handoffs so model and reasoning-effort changes are preserved, and automatic handoffs return to the planning model when automatic prewalk is changed or disabled.

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Changed

  • Improved file memory bank performance by reducing unnecessary disk synchronization during checkpointing, lowering per-turn I/O overhead for banks shared across multiple processes.

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added the PhononTts binding for on-device Phonon text-to-speech.
  • Added Shell.adopt(fork) to apply variables, functions, aliases, options, and traps from a completed fork back to its parent shell. When both shells set a name, the value from the command that finished last is retained.

Fixed

  • Fixed concurrent commitCreate() calls incorrectly overwriting each other’s commit subject and body.

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added support for pasting images into HtmlFormDialog option notes when opened with acceptImages, including image attachment, removal, and access to retained images through OptionNote.images.
  • Added live web-page and image rendering in assistant replies for supported terminals, including inline images and embedded page previews. Added the /btw transcript note for sharing side topics without interrupting the main conversation.

Changed

  • Improved reasoning-capability discovery so models awaiting discovery follow the session's thinking default and offer automatic thinking in addition to disabled and effort-level settings.
  • Renamed the public html-form/media APIs to media, including loadMedia, Media, and MAX_MEDIA_BYTES.

Fixed

  • Fixed fallback model selection so roles are offered only models they can use, excluding incompatible image and speech models.
  • Fixed macOS spelling assistance, autocorrect, replacements, and word completion for shell (!) and Python ($) drafts.

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Fixed

  • Fixed bare URLs swallowing the following word when Korean, Japanese, or Chinese text follows a parenthesized URL without a space.

v0.22.9 Stable2026-11-16T17:45:56Z

oh-my-codex v0.22.9

Summary

This minor release ships updated code-review skill with source-bound continuation and repair receipts. Review receipts now capture and preserve source identity (commit hash, uncommitted changes, file hashes), track scope, requirements, gates, and validation results independently for each review lane, and enforce invalidation rules preventing unverifiable approval of changed source or invalidated evidence.

Added

  • CODE-REVIEW SKILL: SOURCE-BOUND CONTINUATION AND REPAIR RECEIPTS (#4098): The code-review skill now captures source identity in review receipts, distinguishes review operation contexts (fresh review, missing-lane resumption, missing-validation collection, repair re-review, complete evidence termination), and prevents receipt reuse when source, requirements, gates, or validation change. Receipt-based invalidation rules ensure continuation always operates on verified scope and that repair re-review never substitutes lane results. First review runs both lanes in parallel on clean contexts; continuation never drops lanes. Standalone review stays read-only. Fixes #4095.

Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report 0.22.9.
